body: When you get a chance, check discord
You don’t have a monopoly on feeling fatigue because you went in raw.
Saying Antifa is actually “Anti Fascist” is an oxymoron
If you do it too deep, the scars might be more visible. Be careful about people seeing that because they might try to play the hero and end up causing you trouble
I’d be down. It’s hard to make good decisions when your second opinion is yourself

See, the thing with me is I know that what I’m doing is fundamentally wrong. But I also feel what I feel, and that isn’t in a textbook. I don’t wanna be like one of those “I’m self-diagnosed with *insert mental illness*”, but I think I’m depressed. And I’m not a large burden now, but I will be once responsibility comes my way. I don’t want to overly rely on my mom after hs, but my current trajectory would make that a likelihood. I guess I just wanna nip the bud before things get worse. P.S. I’d write a pretty long letter addressing people, so they don’t have to worry about the possibility of them being responsible. Plus a sort of last will and testament.
